lines: 一块太阳能板，只需要做一件事：|一整天都转过去，正对着太阳。
A solar panel has only one job:|turn all day long to face the sun.
可在《戴森球计划》里，|一颗星球上铺满了成千上万块，|恒星周围还飞着几十万张太阳帆。
But in Dyson Sphere Program,|a single planet is paved with thousands of them,|and hundreds of thousands of sails circle the star.
每一块都在转。这么多东西，|游戏到底每一帧要算多少？
Every one of them is turning.|How much does the game have to compute each frame?
这一期，我们看怎么让一百万个东西，一起追着太阳转。
This episode: how to make a million things track the sun at once.
最直接的写法：每块板每帧在 CPU 上，|先找到太阳，转动底座，再把面板仰起来，|算出一个 4×4 矩阵，传给显卡。
The direct way: every panel, every frame, on the CPU:|find the sun, turn the base, tilt the face up,|build a 4×4 matrix and hand it to the GPU.
我在这台电脑上测了一下：|一百万块板，光算矩阵就要 46 毫秒，|每帧还得上传 61 MB 数据。
I measured it on this machine:|for a million panels the matrices alone take 46 milliseconds,|and 61 megabytes have to be uploaded every frame.
可这些板的变化，其实全都能从太阳位置推出来。
Yet everything about how these panels change follows from where the sun is.
那就把这段数学，搬进顶点着色器。
So move that math into the vertex shader.
每块板只存一次：它在星球上的方向，加一个随机数，16 个字节，|开局上传，之后再也不动。
Each panel is stored once: its direction on the planet plus a random number, sixteen bytes,|uploaded at the start and never touched again.
每一帧，CPU 只发两个数：星球转到了哪，太阳在哪。|顶点着色器自己转底座、仰面板。
Each frame, the CPU sends just two values: how far the planet has turned, and where the sun is.|The vertex shader turns the base and tilts the face on its own.
转到夜晚的一侧，太阳落下地平线，|板子就平放下来，等下一次日出。
On the night side, once the sun sets below the horizon,|the panels lie flat and wait for the next sunrise.
太空里的太阳帆更极端：几十万张，每一张都在绕着恒星转。
Out in space, the solar sails go further: hundreds of thousands, each orbiting the star.
它们甚至什么都不用存。|只用编号算出哈希，就能定出轨道、半径和起始角，|再按开普勒定律，越靠里的转得越快。
They don't need to store anything at all.|A hash of each sail's index fixes its orbit, radius and starting angle,|and by Kepler's law, inner orbits run faster.
位置就是编号和时间的函数。|这里的一百零四万八千五百七十六张帆，只用一次绘制。
Position is just a function of index and time.|These one million forty-eight thousand five hundred seventy-six sails take a single draw call.
据社区 Mod 作者的分析，|《戴森球计划》也是用一次程序化绘制，|画出所有远处的太阳帆。
According to a community mod author's analysis,|Dyson Sphere Program also draws all the distant sails|with one procedural draw call.
戴森壳的六边形也是一样。|社区 Mod SphereOpt 把它们改成实例化，|每层一次绘制，而不是每块壳一次。
The hexagons of the Dyson shell work the same way.|The community mod SphereOpt switched them to instancing:|one draw call per layer instead of one per shell.
在一颗有 5240 块壳的戴森球上，|作者测到帧率从 18 提到了 85 左右。
On a sphere with 5,240 shells,|its author measured the frame rate going from 18 to about 85.
还有一招是不画、少画。|离得近的太阳帆，游戏画成实心模型；|远处的，只是一张平面贴片。
Another move is to draw less, or nothing.|Sails up close are drawn as solid meshes;|far away, they're just flat sprites.
SphereOpt 也给框架和节点加了细节层级和视锥剔除：|戴森球不在画面里时，帧率大幅上升。
SphereOpt also added level of detail and frustum culling for frames and nodes:|when the sphere is out of view, the frame rate jumps.
四期下来，招式其实只有几种：|局部规则、空间网格、数据和逻辑分开，|再把能算的都交给 GPU。
Four episodes in, there are really only a few moves:|local rules, a spatial grid, data kept apart from logic,|and everything computable handed to the GPU.
下一期，我们把它们合在一起。
Next time, we put them all together.
